rows.label: qst703005_msg0001
rows.name:
Your Majesty, everyone, thank you
very much for all your help.

rows.label: qst703005_msg0002
rows.name:
The Gulan special envoy arrived
safely. Now the conference can begin.

rows.label: qst703005_msg0003
rows.name: I am glad to hear it.

rows.label: qst703005_msg0004
rows.name:
There are the Shiyan troops,
and Heaven's Holy Grail...

rows.label: qst703005_msg0005
rows.name:
Not to mention the state of
affairs in Superbia and Gula...

rows.label: qst703005_msg0006
rows.name:
Alst seems to be heading
for a period of unrest...

rows.label: qst703005_msg0007
rows.name:
Please have a meaningful discussion
on how Superbia and Gula can work
together through these hardships.

rows.label: qst703005_msg0008
rows.name: It will be done, Your Majesty.

rows.label: qst703005_msg0010
rows.name:
Later, tell me what you thought of
the Melosian Honey you worked so
hard to get.
